critical_code_review_comments: VideoEditor.jsx and AdminPanel.jsx > SessionVideosTab.uploadFor duplicate the TUS setup block (metadata, retryDelays, onError, onProgress, onSuccess). Consider extracting into a shared `lib/tusUpload.js` helper so future tweaks (chunk size, retry policy, 413 message) don't have to be applied twice.
Both files hard-code the bucket name 'session-videos'. Move to a single constant in a shared module.

AdminPanel.jsx is 1204 lines and mixes admin dashboard, waitlist, users, curriculum, videos, payments, and payouts tabs. Consider splitting into per-tab files under /components/admin/ — this file is well over the 700-line file-size guideline.

Testid inconsistency (minor, does not affect functionality): the review request references `admin-tab-session-videos` but the actual testid is `admin-tab-videos`. Both AdminPanel tab and SessionVideosTab still work correctly. If external QA references the review-request name, either add an alias data-testid or update docs.
